answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, and weight its reputation by stake-days rather than by account count. Splitting one budget into a hundred hollow identities leaves each with a negligible weight, so votes gain nothing. Trust spreads only through vouching, and a voucher's own stake is slashed when a vouchee is caught colluding, so one exposed fake makes a plume of penalties travel up the chain. A ripple of slashing thus makes mass forgery cost more than it earns.
